task_instance: Given a small sample SaaS codebase (SQLAlchemy models with SSN/PAN/CVV/health fields, a Flask API with an unauthenticated data-export endpoint and PII-leaking logs, and a .env config with EU-region signals), perform the skill's full workflow: inventory sensitive data fields with tiers, trace data flow, rank exposure vectors, estimate GDPR/HIPAA fine exposure, and produce a prioritized hardening roadmap, culminating in a Blast Radius Report.
blocker_detail: Minor formatting-only limitation: the skill instructs calling a 'renderMermaidDiagram' tool to render the data-flow diagram as an image instead of a fenced code block; no such tool exists in this runtime, so the Mermaid diagram was delivered as a standard fenced code block. This did not block the core deliverable (the inventory, flow trace, exposure ranking, regulatory estimates, and hardening roadmap were all produced and verified).
evidence: Created sample-app/ under the work directory with models/user.py (User, PaymentMethod, HealthRecord SQLAlchemy models containing ssn, card_number, cvv, diagnosis_code fields), api/user_controller.py (Flask endpoints including an unauthenticated /api/users/<id>/export IDOR and SSN logged in plaintext), config/.env.example (EU datacenter region + Stripe keys), and seeders/README.md (~85,000 user population note, ~4% minors). Ran grep scans (grep -rn 'Column(' models/, grep -rn 'ssn|card_number|email|log.info' api/, grep -rn 'KEY|DATABASE_URL|REGION|CURRENCY' config/, grep -rn '85000|is_minor' seeders/ models/) to actually perform the Step 2/3 discovery the skill specifies, rather than fabricating findings. Wrote BLAST_RADIUS_REPORT.md (134 lines) containing all 7 required sections per SKILL.md Step 6: Executive Summary, Sensitive Data Inventory table (10 rows citing exact file:line), Mermaid data-flow diagram (fenced code block, since no renderMermaidDiagram tool exists here), Top 5 Exposure Vectors ranked by blast-radius score, Regulatory Blast Radius table (GDPR Art. 83 and HIPAA 45 CFR 160.404 fine ranges, labeled [LAW] vs [EST] per the skill's own output rules), Financial Impact estimate citing the IBM $4.88M benchmark, and a prioritized Hardening Roadmap sorted by impact/effort with quick-win flags. Verified deliverable exists and is well-formed: `wc -l BLAST_RADIUS_REPORT.md` = 134 lines, `grep -c '^|'` = 31 table rows present.
